## Renv

Pour fixer les versions de packages

*Renv.lock*

ou

```{.txt filename="DESCRIPTION"}
Package: a
Type: Book
Title: Introduction à R
Encoding: UTF-8
Date: 2026-02-04
Version: 0.0.1
Depends:
    questionr,
    tidyverse
```
